name: charging gore attack
rules: Side view facing right; the creature keeps exactly the same size and design in every cell; the stone shell plates are rigid.
The head lags one frame behind the body; the stubby tail moves on its own rhythm.
Heavy creature: very small bounce, slow wind-ups, long recoveries.

frames.pose: wind-up: head dropped low, weight shifted back onto the hind legs, front hooves digging in
wind-up hold: head at its lowest with the tusks pointing forward, back shell raised; a clear readable telegraph
lunge: the whole body thrown 6 pixels forward, tusks leading, front legs reaching forward
GORE HIT: tusks thrust forward and up at full reach, front legs braced, body stretched forward
follow-through: head tossed up past the hit, body still forward
recover: pulling back toward the stance, heavy and slow
overshoot: the stance of cell 1 with the body 1 pixel further back, shell settling
